title: plantseed_annotation refdata bundle manifest
description: Manifest for a versioned refdata bundle under <BUNDLE_ROOT>/<version>/. Written by refbuild/stamp_version.py; consumed by plantseed_annotation.reference at annotation time.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS manifest schema. Bumped when the manifest structure changes.

bundle_version.description: Human-readable version tag (v1, v2, v2.1, ...). Monotonic. Advances on any input change: new curator PR, new Phytozome release, new tool major version.

created_utc.description: UTC timestamp when refbuild/stamp_version.py finalized this bundle.

roles_json_sha.description: git SHA of Data/PlantSEED_v3/PlantSEED_Roles.json at bundle build time. This is the single most important pin: any curator PR that touches roles changes this SHA and forces a bundle rebuild.

complexes_json_sha.description: git SHA of Data/PlantSEED_v3/PlantSEED_Complexes.json at bundle build time.

phytozome_release.description: Phytozome release identifier used for the baseline OrthoFinder run (e.g., 'V12', 'V13').

shoot_db_build_id.description: SHOOT database build identifier — hash of the OrthoFinder results directory + SHOOT tool version. Changes when the SHOOT db was regenerated even if roles didn't change.

curation_repo_url.description: Upstream repo the roles/complexes files were sourced from. Almost always github.com/ModelSEED/PlantSEED but recorded for provenance.

tool_versions.description: Versions of every external tool involved in building the bundle. Used by verify() to warn on version drift between build-time and run-time environments.

plantseed_annotation.description: This package's version at bundle build time.

contents.description: Per-file SHA-256 for every artifact inside the bundle directory. reference.verify() diffs on-disk hashes against these.

bytes_total.description: Total on-disk bytes. Compared to config.get(tier).refdata_gb_max at load time; over-cap loads fail on the KBase tier.

og_count.description: Number of orthogroups in orthofinder_families_enriched/. Pruning kept only PlantSEED-adjacent OGs + close neighbors.

protein_count.description: Total protein sequences across all OGs (Arabidopsis + curated non-Arabidopsis + reference-species neighbors).

curated_non_arabidopsis.description: Every non-Arabidopsis PlantSEED-curated protein that was SHOOT-placed into the enriched families this run. Recorded here so the manifest itself documents which specialized pathways the bundle covers.

id.description: Source-native id (UniProt accession, Phytozome locus, etc.)

og.description: OrthoFinder OG id it was placed into (e.g., 'OG0001234')

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the placed sequence (for incremental rebuild cache)

pathway_role.description: The abstract_enzyme / role from PlantSEED_Roles.json this protein backs

delta_vs_previous.description: Optional. Difference from the previous bundle version — populated by refbuild/stamp_version when a previous bundle is available on the same host.
